Yes. Free cash flow conversion (operating cash flow minus capex, divided by net income) improved at Adobe in FY2022. The passages give no Adobe-reported figure, so this is derived from the cash flow statement [5].

- FY2022: ($7,838M − $442M) / $4,756M ≈ 155.5% [5]
- FY2021: ($7,230M − $348M) / $4,822M ≈ 142.7% [5]
- FY2020: ($5,727M − $419M) / $5,260M ≈ 100.9% [5]

Conversion rose each year. Free cash flow was $7,396M in FY2022 and $6,882M in FY2021, while net income fell slightly from $4,822M to $4,756M [5].
